info.description:
REST API for courses, sections, assignments, question banks and tests.
Courses: list/stats use query `user_id` until JWT is enabled. Course status: 0 — Draft, 1 — Active.
Cover image changes publish Kafka events on topic `file-topic` (FileLoadedEvent / FileDeletedEvent).
Tests are also available under `/api` (same handlers as `/cs/v1`).
info.title: Course Service API

get.description: Lists attempts with optional filters. status values: IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, NEEDS_GRADING.

post.description: Starts a new attempt. Optional limit/offset paginate questions in the response. Body: {"testId":10,"userId":42}.

get.description: Returns attempt metadata, remaining time, and paginated questions with answer options (without isCorrect). Each question may include saved response.

put.description: Saves or updates an answer for one question. For SINGLE use selectedAnswerId; for MULTIPLE use selectedAnswerIds array; for TEXT use textResponse. See schemas SaveAttemptAnswerSingleExample, SaveAttemptAnswerMultipleExample, SaveAttemptAnswerTextExample.

post.description: Finishes the attempt and runs auto-grading for choice questions. Text questions may require manual grading (status NEEDS_GRADING).

put.summary: Replace all questions in a bank

put.description: Updates title and description. userId in body must match the bank owner; userId is not changed.

get.description: Returns courses owned by user_id. Filter: if the value is numeric, matches course id; otherwise matches title (case-insensitive substring). Student count is in stats.totalStudents.

parameters.description: Filter by course id or title
parameters.name: filter

post.description: Creates a course with status Draft (0). If coverImageId is set, publishes FileLoadedEvent to Kafka (file-topic).

get.description: Returns count of active courses and total students enrolled on active courses for the instructor.
Returns course metadata (including coverImageId) and nested sections with items (item_type, item_id for file/test/assignment reference).

put.description: Updates course fields. When coverImageId changes, emits FileLoadedEvent and/or FileDeletedEvent to Kafka.

get.description: Returns tests for a course. Query course_id is optional; omit to get all tests.

post.description: Creates a test linked to a course section item. generationSettings is a JSON object: {"shuffleQuestions":true,"difficultyLevels":[1,2,3]}. questionsCount is a top-level field on the test. bankIds lists question banks used for random question generation. Dates are RFC3339 (UTC recommended).

delete.description: Deletes a test. Provide test_id in path or query.

get.description: Returns test metadata and all attempts of the given user for this test.
get.summary: Get test info with user attempts

put.description: Updates test fields. test_id can be passed in path or in body as id. Same body format as create.

delete.description: Deletes a test. Provide test_id in path or query.

get.description: Lists attempts for a specific test. status values: IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, NEEDS_GRADING.
Same response as GET /attempts/{attempt_id}, but validates that the attempt belongs to the given test.
get.summary: Get attempt state within a test

post.description: Assigns scores to text (or other manually graded) questions. Body: {"scores":[{"attemptQuestionId":501,"scoreAwarded":8,"instructorComment":"Partially correct"}]}.
